bull.last: CAT: argues long. Caterpillar is deeply oversold at $694.81, sitting 13.8% below its 200‑day SMA and with an RSI of 30, indicating a short‑term bounce potential. The company’s fundamentals remain strong—18% YoY EPS growth, 54% ROE and a recent streak of EPS surprises up to +30.5%—supporting a rebound. bear.last: CAT: Caterpillar is trading deep in a downtrend, sitting 13.8% below its 200‑day SMA and with a 20‑day decline of 15.1%, suggesting the bearish momentum is still intact. The RSI of 30.3 signals oversold conditions but also warns of a fragile market that could easily slip lower if the anticipated bounce fails. Analyst sentiment is mixed: while the mean target of $945 implies 36% upside, two major houses have slashed their targets to $750 (UBS) and $840 (Wells Fargo), indicating that the upside may already be priced in. Insider activity is bearish, with 14 block sales worth $26.2 M and no purchases in the last 90 days, and short‑volume remains elevated (≈40% of recent trades). Finally, the upcoming earnings on 2026‑10‑29 could reverse the recent EPS surprise trend; a miss or muted revenue guidance would likely trigger further declines amid a high‑beta (1.6) and high‑valuation (PE 29, P/B 12.6) profile.
